Some 70% of Americans oppose local construction of AI data centers — including 75% of Democrats and 63% of Republicans, according to Gallup.

At least 75 data center projects worth $130B were stalled or blocked in the first three months of 2026.

Over the past year, both red AND blue states have passed strict guidelines on data center development and regulations on AI. 

Meanwhile, after lobbying and election spending by Big Tech, Trump has signed his own executive orders to fast-track data center construction and weaken state AI regulation.

New York has become the first state to enact a data center moratorium.

Permits for hyperscale data centers will be paused for a year while the state develops a regulatory framework around AI.

The state is also considering legislation that would strip data centers of tax subsidies.
